definitions.explanation: A period of rest or relaxation to recover energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{休息|きゅうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りましょう→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}な→十分：01614_juubun⟧{休息|きゅうそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{休息|きゅうそく}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: To set aside time for rest.

notes:
{休息|きゅうそく} refers to rest or relaxation, typically to recover from work or exertion.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {休息|きゅうそく}を{取|と}る (to take a rest)
- {休息|きゅうそく}する (to rest)
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な{休息|きゅうそく} (sufficient rest)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {休息|きゅうそく}{時間|じかん} (rest time, break time)
- {休息|きゅうそく}{所|しょ} (rest area, rest stop)

HOMOPHONE:
- {急速|きゅうそく} (rapid) - different meaning, same pronunciation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {休憩|きゅうけい}: break, rest (shorter, during work)
- {休養|きゅうよう}: rest, recuperation (for health)
- {安息|あんそく}: rest, peace (more literary)
